# Prompts for `make capture-claude`, one per line.
# A capture wants at least one plain turn, one that makes the model call a
# tool, and one that makes it call two tools in the same response, so the
# recording carries a text response, a tool_use / tool_result round trip and a
# parallel tool_use / tool_result replay.
Reply with exactly one word: ready
Use the Bash tool to run `echo tool-ok`, then report its exact output.
Use the Bash tool to run `ls | wc -l`, then tell me the number.
In a single response, call the Bash tool twice in parallel: once with `echo alpha` and once with `echo beta`. Then report both outputs.
